key_insight: Born-measured attention enables exact finite-quadrature word evidence for class probabilities with input-fixed denominators, while matching a similarly sized softmax transformer on language inference.
engineering_relevance: The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic and qubit implementations, with a coherent attention layer requiring 23 qubits and 852 CNOTs.
method: Use row-normalized |⟨q|k⟩|⁴ attention, a measured-product nonlinearity, and Born readout.
Freeze denominators at input values to compute polynomial integrated-gradient evidence whose contributions sum correctly to within 10⁻¹¹ or better.
Test attention overlaps on IBM ibm_kingston using Hadamard tests.
evidence_signal: On e-SNLI, the model achieved 76.98 ± 0.17% accuracy versus 76.62 ± 0.36% for softmax; deleting its top-evidence word flipped 45% of predictions versus 32% for equivalently explained softmax.
watch_item: Hardware validation covered only two short test pairs: answers and deletion behavior matched, but word evidence did not survive device noise and needs further shots and calibration.
paper_title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
